---
title: "Turbidity Analysis — Pre- vs Post-Fire by Distance Ring"
output: html_notebook
---

## Setup — Load Libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
```

---

## Load and Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
Turbstuff <- read_csv("Turbidity_with_FireRings.csv")

# Clean dates, rename turbidity column, assign fire period
turby_clean <- Turbstuff %>%
  rename(TURB_DATE = date,
         turbidity = median) %>%
  mutate(
    ALARM_DATE = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", as.character(ALARM_DATE)),
                         format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    TURB_DATE  = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", as.character(TURB_DATE)),
                         format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    FirePeriod = if_else(TURB_DATE < ALARM_DATE, "Pre-Fire", "Post-Fire"),
    FirePeriod = factor(FirePeriod, levels = c("Pre-Fire", "Post-Fire")),
    RING_MIN_KM = as.numeric(sub("\u2013.*|-.*", "", RING_LABEL)),
    RING_LABEL  = reorder(RING_LABEL, RING_MIN_KM)
  ) %>%
  filter(turbidity <= 50000)   # remove extreme outliers

table(turby_clean$FirePeriod, useNA = "ifany")
```

---

## Shared Plot Theme and Colours

```{r shared-aesthetics}
fire_colors <- c("Pre-Fire" = "#1f77b4", "Post-Fire" = "#ff7f0e")
```

---

## Identify Lakes with Post-Fire Turbidity Increase

```{r flag-increases}
# Step 1: Compute max pre- and post-fire turbidity per lake-fire-ring
turb_max <- turby_clean %>%
  group_by(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL) %>%
  summarise(
    max_pre  = if (any(FirePeriod == "Pre-Fire"  & !is.na(turbidity)))
                 max(turbidity[FirePeriod == "Pre-Fire"],  na.rm = TRUE)
               else NA_real_,
    max_post = if (any(FirePeriod == "Post-Fire" & !is.na(turbidity)))
                 max(turbidity[FirePeriod == "Post-Fire"], na.rm = TRUE)
               else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Flag groups where post > pre
turb_increased_ids <- turb_max %>%
  filter(!is.na(max_pre) & !is.na(max_post) & max_post > max_pre)

# Step 3: Join back to full records
turb_increased_full <- turby_clean %>%
  inner_join(turb_increased_ids,
             by = c("DFGWATERID", "FireID", "RING_LABEL"))
```

---

## Ridgeline Plots — All Lakes vs Increased Only

```{r ridgeline-all-vs-increased}
# All lakes
ggplot(turby_clean,
       aes(x = turbidity, y = RING_LABEL, fill = FirePeriod)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.6, scale = 1.1, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Pre- vs Post-Fire Turbidity — All Lakes",
       x = "Turbidity", y = "Distance from Fire",
       fill = "Fire Period") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Lakes with post-fire increase only
ggplot(turb_increased_full,
       aes(x = turbidity, y = RING_LABEL, fill = FirePeriod)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.5, scale = 1.1, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Lakes with Increased Turbidity Post-Fire",
       x = "Turbidity", y = "Distance from Fire",
       fill = "Fire Period") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

---

## Turbidity Change — Post minus Pre

```{r turbidity-change}
turb_diff <- turby_clean %>%
  group_by(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, FirePeriod) %>%
  summarise(mean_turbidity = mean(turbidity, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = FirePeriod,
              values_from = mean_turbidity) %>%
  mutate(turbidity_change = `Post-Fire` - `Pre-Fire`) %>%
  ungroup()

# Distribution of increases only
turb_diff_increased <- turb_diff %>%
  filter(turbidity_change > 0)

ggplot(turb_diff_increased,
       aes(x = turbidity_change, y = RING_LABEL, fill = RING_LABEL)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.1, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Increase in Turbidity After Fire by Distance Ring",
       x = "Turbidity Change (Post − Pre)",
       y = "Distance from Fire") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

---

## Paired Wilcoxon Tests — Pre vs Post by Lake-Fire-Ring

```{r wilcoxon-paired}
turb_paired_indiv <- turby_clean %>%
  arrange(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, TURB_DATE) %>%
  group_by(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL) %>%
  summarise(
    pre_values  = list(turbidity[FirePeriod == "Pre-Fire"]),
    post_values = list(turbidity[FirePeriod == "Post-Fire"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(pre_values,  ~ length(.x) > 0) &
         map_lgl(post_values, ~ length(.x) > 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    test = map2(pre_values, post_values, ~ {
      n <- min(length(.x), length(.y))
      if (n < 1) return(NA)
      wilcox.test(.x[1:n], .y[1:n], paired = TRUE)
    }),
    increase  = map2_dbl(pre_values, post_values,
                          ~ mean(.y - .x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    p_value   = map_dbl(test, ~ ifelse(is.list(.x), .x$p.value,   NA)),
    statistic = map_dbl(test, ~ ifelse(is.list(.x), .x$statistic, NA))
  ) %>%
  select(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL,
         pre_values, post_values, increase, p_value, statistic)

turb_paired_indiv
```

---

## Final Ridgeline Plots from Paired Data

```{r final-ridgeline-plots}
# Stack pre/post for plotting
turb_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  turb_paired_indiv %>%
    select(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, pre_values) %>%
    rename(turbidity = pre_values) %>%
    mutate(FirePeriod = "Pre-Fire") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(turbidity)),
  turb_paired_indiv %>%
    select(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, post_values) %>%
    rename(turbidity = post_values) %>%
    mutate(FirePeriod = "Post-Fire") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(turbidity))
) %>%
  filter(turbidity <= 50000)

# All lakes
ggplot(turb_plot_data,
       aes(x = turbidity, y = RING_LABEL, fill = FirePeriod)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.6, scale = 1.1, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 250)) +
  labs(title = "Pre- vs Post-Fire Turbidity by Distance from Fire",
       x = "Turbidity", y = "Distance from Fire") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Lakes with post-fire increase only
turb_increase_plot <- bind_rows(
  turb_paired_indiv %>%
    filter(increase > 0) %>%
    select(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, pre_values) %>%
    rename(turbidity = pre_values) %>%
    mutate(FirePeriod = "Pre-Fire") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(turbidity)),
  turb_paired_indiv %>%
    filter(increase > 0) %>%
    select(DFGWATERID, FireID, RING_LABEL, post_values) %>%
    rename(turbidity = post_values) %>%
    mutate(FirePeriod = "Post-Fire") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(turbidity))
) %>%
  filter(turbidity <= 50000)

ggplot(turb_increase_plot,
       aes(x = turbidity, y = RING_LABEL, fill = FirePeriod)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.6, scale = 1.1, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fire_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Lakes with Increased Turbidity Post-Fire",
       x = "Turbidity", y = "Distance from Fire") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
